question: Should direct core Copilot request paths be migrated to a generic provider-owned header/auth seam in this PR, rather than retaining a second core-owned Copilot runtime identity?
rationale: The patch fixes a real provider-auth problem, but choosing whether to preserve or remove the remaining core-specific Copilot path determines the long-term provider boundary and cannot safely be inferred from the contributor patch alone.

options.title: Use one provider-owned identity
options.body: Recommended: remove the duplicate core policy and route the affected core callers through a generic provider-owned request-header/auth seam.

options.title: Accept the split ownership temporarily
options.body: Keep both constants only with an explicit maintainer decision and focused tests that prove every affected surface remains synchronized.

recommendation.title: Use one provider-owned identity
recommendation.body: Recommended: remove the duplicate core policy and route the affected core callers through a generic provider-owned request-header/auth seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the current provider-auth change and can explain the affected request paths; a repository owner should make the final boundary decision.
